name: Roadmap
description: A read-only board of your team's roadmap: what needs a decision, what's Now, Next and Later, and who changed what and why. It reads roadmap/roadmap.json from one GitHub repo.
purpose: shows your team's roadmap from GitHub, read-only
author: Dork Labs

secrets.label: GitHub token
secrets.description: A fine-grained personal access token for the one repo that holds roadmap/roadmap.json: Contents read-only and Metadata read-only, nothing else. It stays on this computer and is only sent to api.github.com.

settings.label: Repo
settings.description: The GitHub repo that holds roadmap/roadmap.json, as owner/name.

settings.label: Who decides
settings.description: The name on the decisions lane, as in "Needs Sam". Leave it empty for "Needs you".

settings.label: Who keeps the roadmap
settings.description: The handle that "Ask in this room" mentions, without the @.

settings.label: Repo for PR numbers
settings.description: A link to a pull request written as a bare number opens in this repo (owner/name). Leave it empty to show bare numbers as text.
